Generating long content with LLMs presents a challenge due to the substantial memory requirements of the transient state, known as the key-value (KV) cache, which scales with sequence length and batch size. This blog reviews InfiniGen, a novel KV cache management framework designed specifically for long-text generation, which integrates seamlessly with modern offloading-based inference systems, which leverage larger CPU memory. InfiniGen leverages a key insight: only a few essential tokens are [...] tokens are necessary to compute the attention layers of Transformers in subsequent steps. By speculating on these critical tokens using the inputs of the current layer and part of the query weight and key cache of the next layer, InfiniGen enables prefetching of only the essential KV cache entries, thus reducing fetch overhead from host CPU memory in offloading-based LLM systems. [...] ## Transformer Block Execution Styles

Modern LLM serving systems like DeepSpeed and FlexGen support offloading model weights or the KV cache to CPU memory. However, offloading-based inference systems face a critical bottleneck due to limited PCIe bandwidth between CPU and GPU, making the size of the KV cache a significant challenge.

## AI Overview

When an LLM generates long text, it stores keys and values from earlier tokens so it need not recompute them. This store is the KV cache, and it grows with sequence length and batch size. Offloading the cache from GPU to larger CPU memory helps fit the workload. However, fetching it back over the CPU–GPU connection can become a major inference cost. [...] Transformer-based large language models (LLMs) demonstrate impressive performance across various natural language processing tasks. Serving LLM inference for generating long contents, however, poses a challenge due to the enormous memory footprint of the transient state, known as the key-value (KV) cache, which scales with the sequence length and batch size. In this paper, we present InfiniGen, a novel KV cache management framework tailored for long-text generation, which synergistically works [...] overhead from the host memory in offloading-based LLM serving systems. Our evaluation on several representative LLMs shows that InfiniGen improves the overall performance of a modern offloading-based system by up to 3.00x compared to prior KV cache management methods while offering substantially better model accuracy.

# InfiniGen: Efficient Generative Inference of Large Language Models with Dynamic KV Cache Management

## Abstract

InfiniGen is a KV cache management framework that improves performance and accuracy in long-text generation by pre-fetching essential KV cache entries in offloading-based LLM serving systems.
